content.title: THE DAILY {{MINIMUMS}} YOUR BODY SECRETLY RUNS ON
facts: **Cold water** -> 1 glass on waking -> Jumpstarts digestion
**Stretching** -> 5 min before bed -> Fewer night wakeups
**Social connection** -> 1 real conversation/day -> Boosts mood stability
**Darkness** -> Screens off 1 hour before bed -> Deeper sleep cycles
**Follow along** -> for more daily health tips like this -> Stay consistent
content.caption:
A few of these daily minimums do more than people realize. Sunlight exposure early in the day helps anchor your circadian rhythm by signaling to your brain when to release and later suppress melatonin, which is why that simple habit can make falling asleep at night so much easier. Walking for even 20 minutes taps into your parasympathetic nervous system, slowing your heart rate and helping clear out built-up cortisol from a stressful day. And that cup of leafy greens isn't just filler - the slow-digesting fiber and steady micronutrient release keep your blood sugar from spiking and crashing, which is often the real reason for that 3pm energy dip. Everyone's body is different, so start with whichever one feels most doable for you.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organ function, and small daily habits into pieces that are actually easy to apply. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic routines instead of chasing quick fixes that never stick.
